capabilities: Read the entire active note aloud
Read selected text or from the cursor to the end
Choose from installed macOS voices and adjust speech rate
Filter which content types (code, math, tables, links) are spoken
extras: Works only on macOS (tested on macOS Tahoe 26 and later); shows a notice on other platforms. No pause/resume or progress indicator because the say command does not support them.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to have notes spoken aloud, and web-based TTS options need internet access, API keys or subscriptions.
summary: Text-to-speech reader that reads notes aloud using the built-in macOS say command, with voice selection, speed control and content filters.
